name: Overflowing Ki
body:
“It’s simple, I don’t run out of power.”.

Prerequisite(s): Yakuza 7th, ki class feature

Benefit(s): You are treated as though you always had at least 1 point in your ki for the purpose of abilities which require points to be remaining in your ki. If you have 0 points in your ki, you can meditate for 1 hour to regain 1 point of ki.
